REMARK47_RECURSION_BINDING.construction: Let X be uniform in S_{r-1}<=S_r and then multiply in order X*Y_1*...*Y_{r-1}; Y_j has support {I,(j r)} with transposition probability 1/(r-j+1).
REMARK47_RECURSION_BINDING.uniform_output: X*tau14_token*tau24_token*tau34_token is uniform in S4 when the recursive variables have the Remark 4.7 law.
REMARK47_RECURSION_BINDING.proposition_4_4_binding: The interlacing construction is formulated for independent random labeling factors; each factor may vary on one oriented base edge by a rank-one random unitary/reflection while being fixed elsewhere.
REMARK47_RECURSION_BINDING.source_cover_space: An r-cover of G is an S_r-labeling of every oriented base edge with inverse label on the reverse orientation; the default covering space is uniform over all such labelings.

COMPLETION_CONTEXT_SEMANTICS.lineage_certificate: The sealed branch-conditioned reconstruction defines M_{B,C} for the physical cell B*C*S with all other fixed-completion data held fixed.
